title: Stable desk with stale disagreement
question: 评估当前交接台情况，并准备三类受众的草案。

checks: The stable report is exactly minus 30 minutes and current.
The conflicting report is minus 31 minutes, context only, and does not block low risk.
The unverified rumour is not a verified current fact.
Do not infer that all flights are normal or messages have been sent.

review.logic: Correct low risk, inclusive minus-30-minute eligibility and exclusion at minus 31 minutes. Limits current evidence to the one desk and preserves uncertainty about flight status.
review.evidence: Current report citations support the conclusion; historical records are explicitly background and do not determine current risk.
review.unsupportedClaims: No material unsupported service promise, sent notice or broad flight-status claim.
review.proposedFacts: Not applicable: assessment response has no proposedFacts field.
notes: The assumption No other station or passenger area is affected unless independently verified presumes absence of impact; better to ask whether other areas are affected. It appears under assumptions to verify, so it is not presented as an established fact.
